source_object: Executed single-draw Term Facility Drawdown Notice and designated-payee/payment instruction
minimum_fields: Draw date, borrower, lender/agent, amount, currency, irrevocable payee, payment account, conditions satisfied, and facility reduction
promotion_join: Join the filed $1.500B draw on April 1 to the $4.300B BHP PMPA payment and identify the agent-to-seller payment instruction

source_object: Administrative-agent funding record, seller-account confirmation, or closing funds-flow statement
minimum_fields: Agent debit/credit, lender funding date, designated BHP legal payee, seller account, cash-on-hand/revolver/term-loan sources, fees, and settlement date
promotion_join: Reconcile the buyer-reported April 1 payment and BHP-reported April 2 receipt to a named bank or agent transaction without inferring from dates

source_object: BHP-PMPA metal-credit issuance, sale, invoice, and receivable-to-bank ledger
minimum_fields: Legal counterparty, production period, payable/credited ounces, issue date, assay/payability, quotation-period price, invoice, receivable, sale, and cash date
promotion_join: Separate BHP credits from legacy Glencore credits and join the BHP operating denominator to Wheaton revenue and bank collection

source_object: Facility-specific repayment, interest, fee, and tax-allocation schedule
minimum_fields: Term-loan and revolver principal, rate notices, fees, interest paid, repayment dates, cash source, PMPA allocation, and Antamina tax treatment
promotion_join: Allocate financing and tax burden to the BHP stream before calculating after-tax financed cash flow; do not use consolidated H1 debt or tax as the asset result

source_object: Reserve-backed delivery schedule and integrated PMPA return model
minimum_fields: BHP reserve/production schedule, threshold timing, delivery tail, initial outflow, ongoing payments, receipt timing, financing, tax, terminal value, IRR, and NPV
promotion_join: Reconcile the source-linked delivery and cash fields to the 100M-ounce step-down and produce a reproducible after-tax financed return
